intro: Four small answers about time, and adverbs ending in -mente.
p.ya.consejo: It says something has already changed: «ya he comido». With «voy» it means you are on your way: «ya voy».
p.ya no.consejo: It says something ended: «ya no vivo allí». It is the opposite of «todavía».
p.todavía.consejo: It says something continues: «todavía vivo allí». It has an accent on the í: to-da-BÍ-a.
p.todavía no.consejo: It says something has not happened, but will: «todavía no he comido». It answers «¿ya…?».
p.aún.consejo: With an accent it means «todavía»: «aún vivo allí». Without one, «aun» usually means «even».
p.aún no.consejo: It is the same as «todavía no»: «aún no he comido». It has an accent on the ú.
p.rápidamente.consejo: It is formed with the feminine «rápida» + «mente». The accent of «rápida» stays.
p.fácilmente.consejo: It is formed with «fácil» + «mente». «Fácil» does not change in the feminine, and the accent stays.
p.normalmente.consejo: It is formed with «normal» + «mente». It says what happens almost always: «normalmente ceno tarde».
p.casi.consejo: It says something is about to happen or to be true: «casi estoy lista».
p.por fin.consejo: It is written as two words: «por fin». It says something awaited arrives: «¡por fin!».
p.lista.consejo: With «estar», «lista» means «ready»: «estoy lista». With «ser», it means «clever».
b1.titulo: Has it happened yet? Is it still going on?
b1.texto:
These are four small answers:

- **ya**: it has happened. **Ya** he terminado.
- **todavía no** (or **aún no**): it has not happened yet. **Todavía no** he comido.
- **todavía** (or **aún**): it continues. **Todavía** vivo allí.
- **ya no**: it has stopped. **Ya no** vivo allí.

They answer each other:

- ¿**Ya** has comido? — **Todavía no.**
- ¿**Todavía** trabajas allí? — **Ya no.**

**Aún** takes an accent; **aun** without one usually means «even».

Adverbs in **-mente** are made with the feminine adjective: rápida → **rápidamente**, fácil → **fácilmente**, normal → **normalmente**. The accent stays. Bueno and malo have their own: **bien**, **mal**.
b2.f2.texto: Do you still work at the hospital?
b2.f3.texto: No, I do not work there any more.
b2.f7.texto: Yes, at last I am ready.
b4.texto:
Has it happened?

- Yes → **ya**: Ya he terminado.
- No, but it will → **todavía no / aún no**: Todavía no he terminado.

Does it continue?

- Yes → **todavía / aún**: Todavía vivo allí.
- No → **ya no**: Ya no vivo allí.

Adverbs in -mente:

- rápida → **rápidamente**: Habla rápidamente.
- fácil → **fácilmente**: Lo hace fácilmente.
- normal → **normalmente**: Normalmente ceno tarde.
b4.e0.texto: I do not live there any more.
b5.f0.texto: It is still night in the sleeping house.
b5.f1.texto: Already a blue light comes in through the kitchen window.
b5.f2.texto: The water is not boiling yet in the small pot.
b5.f3.texto: Lucía walks barefoot and hardly makes a sound.
b5.f4.texto: Already the whole house smells of coffee and toasted bread.
b5.f5.texto: The sun has not come up yet over the roofs.
b5.f6.texto: The birds are already singing very softly among the branches.
b5.f7.texto: Pablo goes down the stairs slowly so as not to wake anyone.
b5.f8.texto: Normally nobody gets up so early in this house.
b5.f9.texto: The two of them drink their coffee in silence and at last smile.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! «Ya no» says something has ended.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Todavía no vivo» would say you have not yet come to live there.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Casi no vivo allí» says you hardly live there.
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Ya no» says something ended, not that it is missing.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That is it! «Todavía no» is the answer to «¿ya…?».
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Casi no» means «hardly». Here it is nearly there.
b8.frase: Ya no trabajo en el hospital
b8.traduccion: I do not work at the hospital any more
b9.o1.refuerzo: It is written all together, without a space.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Well done! «Fácil» + «mente», and the accent stays.
b9.pregunta: How is the adverb of «fácil» formed?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «I do not live there any more.»
b11.o1.refuerzo: «-mente» joins the feminine, not the masculine.
b11.pregunta: How do you make an adverb from «rápido»?
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Todavía no trabajo» would say you have not started yet.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Casi no» says «hardly», not that it ended.
p.comido.consejo: From «comer», to eat. The -ido ending is the past participle.
p.dormida.consejo: From «dormido». The -a ending matches a feminine noun.
p.hierve.consejo: From «hervir», to boil. The h is silent, and ie sounds like «ye».
p.lentamente.consejo: Made from «lenta» and «-mente». The stress is on MEN.
p.despertar.consejo: The stress is on the last syllable, TAR.
p.beben.consejo: From «beber», to drink. The v and b sound the same in Spanish.
